method: Read each original engine PNG with view_image; no image editing or compositing

observations.hud-task-hidden.png: Same world and fixed bars/companion/items; task heading and description fully absent after five seconds.
observations.hud-medicine.png: Medicine selected below, roast left, arrows above, firepot right; counts readable.
observations.hud-roast.png: Roast selected below, arrows left, firepot above, medicine right; bars and companion stable, no persistent quest.
observations.hud-arrow.png: Arrows selected below, firepot left, medicine above, roast right; hunger updates to 99, labels retained.
observations.hud-firepot.png: Firepot selected below, medicine left, roast above, arrows right; unused item brightness keeps silhouettes identifiable.
